chat.participant.description: Ask about governance status, review handoff, and HITL work.
chat.commands.status.description: Summarize current governance status for the workspace.
chat.commands.review.description: Focus on review lifecycle and handoff guidance.
chat.commands.refresh.description: Refresh the Governor workbench views and the chat snapshot.
chat.commands.workspaceBootstrap.descrip: Run workspace bootstrap from chat and report the refreshed workbench state.
chat.commands.connect.description: Run Governor connect from chat and configure one provider/tool path inside VS Code.
chat.commands.doctor.description: Run Governor doctor from chat and return the refreshed diagnostics snapshot.
chat.commands.check.description: Run Governor check from chat and return the refreshed workbench status.
chat.commands.workflowPreview.descriptio: Preview one workflow from chat. Add a template id after the slash command to skip the picker.
chat.commands.workflowCreate.description: Create one workflow entry from chat. Add a template id after the slash command to skip the picker.
chat.commands.workflowEdit.description: Edit one workflow entry from chat. Add a template id after the slash command to skip the picker.
chat.commands.workflowStudio.description: Open and refresh Workflow Studio from chat.
chat.commands.reviewDetail.description: Open and refresh Review Detail from chat.
chat.commands.handoffTarget.description: Open the preferred Governor handoff target from chat.
chat.commands.repositoryOperation.descri: Run one governed repository operation from chat. You can name an operation such as "upgrade preview" or "host verify" after the slash command.
chat.commands.submitHitlDecision.descrip: Start the HITL decision flow from chat.
chat.commands.recoverExecution.descripti: Request recovery for the selected execution from chat.
chat.commands.terminateExecution.descrip: Start the execution-termination flow from chat.
chat.commands.openUserConfig.description: Open the canonical user-config file from chat.
chat.commands.configureUserDefault.descr: Start the user-default authoring flow from chat.
chat.commands.setManagedSecret.descripti: Start the managed-secret authoring flow from chat.
